## Report — Bundle 8d (S-VLADW1-03)

**D1 — out of scope, not touched.** Moved to bundle 8a per brief; `driver/host-free-driver.js` was never edited by me (confirmed clean diff-of-mine).

**D2 — FIXED, CLASS.** `job-manager.js` now imports `isValidPermissionLevel` from `./permission.js` and calls it instead of `Boolean(permissionLevel)`. This closes the CLASS ("a check named for validity that computed truthiness") — the fix delegates to the real validator rather than adding a narrower ad hoc truthiness test, so no future bogus-but-truthy string can slip through.

**D3 — FIXED, CLASS.** `cancelJob` now returns `idempotent:true`/`false` from the branch actually taken (the transition-performing branch returns `false` immediately; every other path — already-terminal or already-cancellation-requested — falls to `idempotent:true`). Exact new logic:
```js
if (isTerminal(record.state)) return { jobId, state: record.state, idempotent: true };
if (record.state !== STATES.CANCELLATION_REQUESTED) {
  record.cancelRequested = true;
  this.#transition(record, STATES.CANCELLATION_REQUESTED);
  return { jobId, state: record.state, idempotent: false };
}
return { jobId, state: record.state, idempotent: true };
```
This closes the CLASS ("flag reports the state's class, not the call's own effect") for this method — it's not a special-case patch for one state pair.

**D4 — FIXED, CLASS.** `extractSignalText`→`extractSignalCandidates` now returns an **array** of independent candidates (each `.errors[i]` entry plus `.message`, never joined), and `matchesQuotaExhaustionPrefix` tests each candidate independently with `.some()`. The `Error`-instance short-circuit was removed — `Error`/`AggregateError` now falls through the same `typeof signal === "object"` branch as any other object, so `.errors` is read on Error instances too. This closes the CLASS β flagged ("the predicate asks the wrong question" — testing a blob instead of testing each real candidate) for this matcher; AC-9.4's capacity-string test and the existing single-entry tests still pass unchanged.

**D5 — FIXED, INSTANCE (named residual below).** New test `test/quota.test.js::D-5 (durability)` imports `USAGE_LIMIT_ERROR_PREFIXES` directly from the installed `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` package (it's a real public named export — confirmed via `import()`, unlike the credential-var group model-seam.test.js's D-2 test has to regex out of raw source), asserts it's a non-empty array (fails loudly, not skip, if the export vanishes), then asserts `deepEqual` of the sorted local corpus vs. sorted SDK corpus. `QUOTA_EXHAUSTION_PREFIXES_DOCUMENTATION_DERIVED` is now exported from `src/quota.js` so the test can compare it directly rather than re-deriving it. **Residual:** this only re-verifies the copy at test-run time (CI/local `npm test`), not on `npm install`/dependency-bump alone — a version bump that ships without a subsequent test run wouldn't be caught until someone runs the suite. That's the same shape D-2's durability test already accepts in this repo, so I followed the existing pattern rather than inventing a stronger enforcer (e.g., a postinstall hook) unprompted.
